lifeCalibration.pageLead: Leave just a few good years and hard years. We use them to read your next fortune and consultation in step with your own flow.
lifeCalibration.signinBody: Your past-years record is saved only to the self card in your account.
lifeCalibration.errorTitle: The connection is a little unsteady
lifeCalibration.errorBody: What you entered is still here. Please try again in a moment.
lifeCalibration.consentTitle: [Optional] Consent to collect and use life-experience information for personalized consultations
lifeCalibration.consentItems: Items collected: good and hard years, how strongly you felt them, the area, and short notes you type yourself
lifeCalibration.consentPurpose: Purpose: personalized interpretation of fortune and consultation results, and period-by-period guidance in your diary
lifeCalibration.consentRetention: Retention: deleted without delay when you withdraw consent, delete that profile, or close your account
lifeCalibration.consentTransfer: Processing: it may be sent to Google LLC's (USA) Gemini API to generate AI consultations (international transfer).
lifeCalibration.consentOptional: Even if you do not agree, you can use every fortune service exactly as you do now.
lifeCalibration.consentAgeNeeded: Please confirm that you are 14 or older.
lifeCalibration.selfBody: Your past-years record can be kept on one self card only. You can switch to another card later.
lifeCalibration.selfEmpty: There are no saved profile cards yet. Please make a card with your birth date first.
lifeCalibration.graphHint: Tap a year to add what happened that year.
lifeCalibration.emptyBody: Start with one year you remember. It is fine to leave it blank too.
lifeCalibration.limitReached: You can keep up to {max} entries.
lifeCalibration.fixFirst: Some rows have no area yet. Please fix them before saving.
lifeCalibration.saveInvalid: Some rows are not in the right format. Please check the year and area.
lifeCalibration.noteEncryption: Notes cannot be saved securely right now. Please clear the notes and save again.
lifeCalibration.noteUnavailable: This note cannot be opened right now
lifeCalibration.domainDuplicate: You can keep only one entry for the same year and area.
lifeCalibration.unsureLabel: I am not sure of the date or details
lifeCalibration.notePlaceholder: e.g. changed jobs, passed an exam
lifeCalibration.noteHint: Please do not write about illness, religion, political views or crime, or other people's real names.
lifeCalibration.cautionTitle: Take another look at the note?
lifeCalibration.cautionBody: We suggest not saving this content. Would you like to edit it?
lifeCalibration.legacyTitle: Earlier notes are on this device
lifeCalibration.legacyBody: You can bring in {count} entries you wrote in a saju reading. They count only after you check them and save.
lifeCalibration.legacyLoaded: These are the entries you brought in. Please check them and save.
lifeCalibration.pattern_none: Add two or more years and we will show the area that comes up most in one line.
lifeCalibration.pattern_good: In your good years, '{domain}' comes up often.
lifeCalibration.pattern_bad: In your hard years, '{domain}' comes up often.
lifeCalibration.pattern_both: '{domain}' often shows up in both your good and hard years.
lifeCalibration.pattern_spread: You have spread your entries across many areas.
lifeCalibration.withdrawBody: If you withdraw consent, the life experiences you entered and the personalized information made from them are deleted together. Consultation results you already received stay as they are; only later results will no longer reflect them.
lifeCalibration.withdrawDone: Consent withdrawn and your entries deleted.
lifeCalibration.offTitle: We are still getting this ready
lifeCalibration.offBody: This screen will open soon. You can keep using the fortune services you use now.
